evals.name: Strict Liveness vs. Readiness Probe Separation
evals.prompt: Review an Express application where a developer put database queries inside the /live liveness check and refactor it into dedicated /live and /ready endpoints to avoid Kubernetes cascading restart loops.
evals.expected_output: Separates /live to purely check event loop responsiveness without external I/O, moving database health checks into /ready.
assertions: Ensures /live liveness probe performs zero external I/O (no DB, Redis, or network calls)
Returns immediate HTTP 200 OK from /live if the process event loop is active
Places upstream backing dependency checks exclusively inside /ready
Eliminates cascading container restart risks in Kubernetes or container orchestrators

evals.name: Readiness Probe Backing Dependency Health & 503 Handling
evals.prompt: Implement a readiness probe at /ready that executes database and cache pings with strict 1000ms timeouts and returns HTTP 503 Service Unavailable when any dependency fails or during server draining.
evals.expected_output: Implements /ready returning 200 when all dependencies pass, and 503 when degraded or draining, with timeout bounds.
assertions: Checks critical backing dependencies (database, cache) in parallel with bounded timeouts
Returns HTTP 503 Service Unavailable immediately when a critical dependency fails or times out
Returns HTTP 503 when the server process is in a connection draining or terminating state
Provides structured JSON indicating which specific dependency is down

evals.name: Diagnostic Telemetry Security & Startup Probe Protection
evals.prompt: Design a protected /health/details endpoint exposing latency breakdown, version, and uptime, and configure a /startup probe to prevent premature liveness kills during cold boot.
evals.expected_output: Provides a structured detailed health diagnostic response restricted from public access and implements /startup for heavy warmup routines.
assertions: Emits comprehensive diagnostic telemetry including uptime, version, and per-check latency in ms
Restricts /health/details access from the public internet via network rules or IP whitelisting
Implements /startup probe returning 200 only after warmup routines complete
Prevents orchestrator cold-start liveness termination stampedes
